findings.title: P2: Make the pipeline mirror connection conditional on client configuration
findings.body: The solid mirror→BuildKit connection omits a required condition. At pinned revision 85e73b1885f04a9494f388cf6622ad0bde2db447, charts/kubeclaw/values.yaml:55-58 explicitly defaults to no mirror; scripts/registry-client-config.mjs:66-74,83-89 adds docker.io routing only when a mirror endpoint is supplied. The runtime entrypoint consumes that generated configuration (docker/buster-runtime-entrypoint.sh:11-29). Deploying or probing the mirror therefore does not establish this connection. Make it conditional on explicit client configuration, update its visible alternative, and qualify the statement that every solid dependency is verified.

findings.title: P2: Limit the Worker database connection to HMAC authentication
findings.body: The selected protected deployment does not execute the depicted Worker→PostgreSQL connection. At 569f7b4933d4859cc67c80ddf40d5154ffd95ce5, skills/prism/server/worker.ts:22-24 constructs WorkerNonceDatabase only in the HMAC branch. worker-service.ts:23,57,80 likewise closes, authenticates against, and checks that database only for HMAC. Supplying DATABASE_URL in the chart does not activate a database consumer in SPIFFE mode. Remove this edge from the selected SPIFFE map or label it explicitly as the alternative HMAC nonce-store dependency, and update the text alternative.

findings.title: P2: Show the secret adapter's environment boundary accurately
findings.body: This edge depicts the capability adapter accessing a Kubernetes Secret, but the selected implementation resolves logical names through a configured environment mapping and reads process.env. At 13bff0a18a64e74f2cbbaa1978e746fcdeff0c10, skills/common/plugins/secret-resolver/plugin.json selects src/adapter.ts, whose lines 3-19 contain that complete resolution path. Nova's allowedNames check (skills/nova/core/execution/authorization.ts:64) limits logical names; it is not Kubernetes Secret API authorization. Relabel the destination as mapped environment credentials, showing Kubernetes Secret injection as a separate deployment boundary if needed, and update the alternative table.
